body:
Runs that die before Landing work step 9 leave branches with no pull request, and nothing comes back for them. This adds `.github/workflows/adopt-stranded-branches.yml`. Every 6h it checks out `oss-monorepo`'s `platform/ci/adopt_stranded.py` (tested there; see Duncan-Haywood/oss-monorepo#7226) and opens a draft PR for each branch whose work `main` still lacks. It opens at most 10 per run. Turn it off with `ADOPT_STRANDED_BRANCHES=false`.

With `--derived 'prompts/*'`, branches that only change files under `prompts/` are skipped, which is what prompt.md step 2 says to do. Dry run today: 32 stranded branches since 2026-09-01. 2 would be adopted (`claude/ecstatic-turing-xzr8iq`, `claude/prompts-in-git`). 30 are skipped as run logs or prompts scaffolding, or because the work later landed through another PR (sag-twin, sample-twin and windup-twin are already on `main`).

This doesn't touch any of the five hand-ported files. **Merge this after Duncan-Haywood/oss-monorepo#7226**, because the job reads the script from that repo's `main`.
